description: This PHP class defines a data model for representing the history of leave periods within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It encapsulates properties such as start month, start day, and creation timestamp, and is used for serializing leave period history data via REST API endpoints.

classes.name: LeavePeriodHistoryModel
classes.description: A PHP model class for serializing leave period history data with properties startMonth, startDay, and createdAt, implementing serialization and normalization traits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LeavePeriodHistoryModel with a LeavePeriodHistory entity, setting up serialization filters and attribute mappings.
